def _pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return None
def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if lang.startswith('ar'): translated = _pattern_translate(text, UI_TEXT_AR) if translated: return translated return text
translated = _pattern_translate(text, AR_TEXT_EN) if translated: return translated
return text
def toast(title, message, kind='warning', sticky=False, next_action=False): params = {'title': ui_text(title), 'message': ui_text(message), 'type': kind, 'sticky': sticky} if next_action: params['next'] = next_action return {'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': params}
